enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.hint: Off leaves the group sheet, the sidebar and the journals exactly as Foundry and the system have them.

showMark.name: Show the mark to players
showMark.hint: A Clue in the party stash wears a bookmark on its row, so a player knows it is worth reading. Off, only the GM sees it.

countUngathered.name: Count the ungathered
countUngathered.hint: Mysteries says how many Clues in the party's hands nobody has read yet.

fvtt-mod-clueboard.elected: This client keeps the Mysteries journals.

mysteries.title: Mysteries
mysteries.empty: Nothing gathered yet. Read a Clue in the party stash and it appears here.
mysteries.noJournal: No Mysteries journal yet: a GM has to be online once for the party's journal to be made.
mysteries.markTooltip: A Clue: reading it goes in Mysteries.

read.title: {name}
read.notePrompt: A note on {name}, in your words, for the whole party to see.
read.notClue: Not a Clue: nothing is recorded.
read.noReader: You have no character in this party, so the read is not recorded.
read.pickReaderHint: You own more than one member of the party. The read is recorded for the one you pick.
read.noJournal: Mysteries has no journal for this party yet: a GM has to be online once. The read is not recorded.
read.failed: Mysteries could not record the read ({reason}).
read.revision: Revision {n}: the item changed while the party held it; this is the text as it reads now.
read.itemGone: The item is gone; the entry keeps what was read.
